race.comment: OCTOBER STAR (7) closed off well second up with a tidy third over 1200m at Wyong in BM64 class. Two subsequent runs have been below par and comes back a few grades here. Maps well and no shock to see him find form. WINNING EMOTIONS (6) struggled in Highway grade at his last two outings and can return to form on his home track. Eye catching run three back when second over 1020m at Moruya. Hard fit for this and keep safe. ONE RUN WON (8) blinkers go on for this after he faded late from the wide gate to finish fourth over 1450m at Illawarra Grange. Can overcome the wide draw and take a hand in the finish. MONTE MAXIMUS (1) won well at Moruya four back and has struggled at the provincials at his last two outings. Claim helps from the low draw and not without each way prospects. JAZZ ALL KNIGHT (10) gets in light with the 4kg claimer and further improved third up.
